title: finding(app-shell): the undo confirmation toast "Change undone" is hard-coded English in both console undo handlers
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (a). `reach:` named real producer: the two console undo handlers below, which every undoable action in the console runs; read at objectui `origin/main` `30f912a0d`. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the landing of PR objectui#11033 (objectui#10969), whose contract review asked for this follow-up card. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, the `useGlobalUndo` options: `onUndo: () => { refresh(); toast.success('Change undone'); }`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, its own `onUndo`: `toast.success('Change undone');`.

## Why it matters

PR objectui#11033 makes the runner's success toast and its Undo button read the session's language (objectui#10969). Pressing that Undo button then shows "Change undone" in English under a zh-CN session: the next toast in the same flow. It is the same class as objectui#10969 (console chrome left English under zh-CN), in two files outside that card's claimed surface.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

One pack key (for example `actions.undone`, beside PR objectui#11033's `actions.undo`) in all ten packs, read through the translator both handlers already have, with a zh pin on each handler and an en control. The dormant English defaults of `toastWithUndo` in `toast-helpers.ts` (zero call sites, per PR objectui#11033's report) are a separate question and not this card.

## Dedupe

The 1021 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `Change undone`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11033 (the source);
- `useGlobalUndo`: 2 hits, PR objectui#11033 and PR objectui#10436 (closed; not this string);
- `onUndo`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11033;
- `toastWithUndo`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11033;
- lit control `I18nLabel`: 23 hits; absent control `zzqq_never_written_token`: 1 hit (objectui#11051, which quotes it as its own absent control).

None carries this string.
